The quartic multiple-tangency instance is previously known, so no stand-alone novelty is claimed for d=4.
Literature/semantic searches are not proof of historical uniqueness; independent priority check remains outstanding.

value.rationale: Complete natural incidence-and-contact classification of all lines containing at least three reflection centres of a recently classified Fermat projection-symmetry locus. It gives a sharp mod-three transition, all multiplicities, a closed contact count and one group orbit uniformly in degree and dimension; this is not an arbitrary slice or a re-count of all known Fermat bitangents.
